name: BioNeMo
tagline: NVIDIA's development platform for AI drug discovery.
description: BioNeMo is NVIDIA's development platform for AI-driven biology and drug discovery. It bundles open biology foundation models, libraries, datasets, and GPU-optimized training recipes, plus NVIDIA NIM microservices that package models for protein structure prediction, molecular design, and virtual screening. The BioNeMo Framework is open source; production models deploy as managed microservices.
insight: Part of NVIDIA Clara; the BioNeMo Framework is open source (Apache-2.0) while production models ship as paid NVIDIA NIM microservices.

modelSupport.notes: Ships biology foundation models (e.g. ESM-2, protein structure) optimized for NVIDIA GPUs.

edge: GPU-optimized recipes claim ~2x faster biofoundation-model training and ~6x faster inference versus unoptimized pipelines.
pros: Prebuilt models for protein and molecule tasks
cons: Steep learning curve for non-ML scientists
